title: UPSC Engineering Services Mains Result 2026
vacancyDetails: 1,341 candidates qualified for Personality Test / Interview based on ESE (Main) written exam
qualification: Engineering Degree (as per UPSC ESE rules for Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics & Telecommunication)
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years (as on 01 January 2026; relaxations as per rules)
selectionProcess: Stage-I Prelims → Stage-II Mains (Written) → Stage-III Personality Test / Interview → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Original certificates for age, educational qualification, community, benchmark disability (if applicable); photo ID; e-Summon Letter for interview
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.upsc.gov.in
2. Open Engineering Services (Main) Examination 2026 Result PDF
3. Search your Roll Number in the PDF
4. Qualified candidates must update details and upload proof of qualifying exam within 15 days on upsconline.nic.in
5. Download e-Summon Letter when interview schedule is published
shortDescription: UPSC has declared the Engineering Services (Main) Examination 2026 written result. Candidates who appeared on 21 June 2026 can check the roll-number-wise list of those shortlisted for Personality Test.
content:
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the result of the written part of the Engineering Services (Main) Examination, 2026 held on 21 June 2026.

Candidates with the mentioned Roll Numbers have qualified for the Interview / Personality Test. The candidature is PROVISIONAL subject to eligibility verification.

Important points

  • About 1,341 candidates have been shortlisted for the Personality Test.
  • A 15-day window will be provided to update details and upload proof of the qualifying engineering examination on the UPSC portal.
  • Interview date and time will be intimated through e-Summon Letter on upsc.gov.in and upsconline.nic.in.
  • Marksheets of all candidates will be available after the final result (post Personality Test) for 30 days.

Candidates should keep original certificates ready and regularly check the Commission’s website for the Roll Number-wise Interview Schedule.
